Please solve this issue: The support console gets a single entry point for refunds. Add `process_refund_request(payment, amount, requested_by, at)` in a new module `ledgerly/support.py`. `amount` is the text the support agent typed (for example "49.99"; amounts with more than two decimals are rounded to the cent), `requested_by` is the agent's user id and `at` is when the request was made. """Entry points used by the support console."""

from . import audit
from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError
from .money import ZERO, round_money

APPROVAL_THRESHOLD = round_money("500.00")


def _parse(amount):
    """Parse the agent-entered amount text into a rounded Decimal."""
    return round_money(amount)


def process_refund_request(payment, amount, requested_by, at, *, approved_by=None):
    """Refund part or all of a captured payment on behalf of a support agent."""
    amount = _parse(amount)
    if amount <= ZERO:
        raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(amount))
    if payment.status != "captured":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"payment {payment.id} is {payment.status}")
    if payment.refunded_amount + amount > payment.amount:
        raise BillingError("refund_exceeds_captured", str(amount))
    if amount > APPROVAL_THRESHOLD and approved_by is None:
        raise BillingError("approval_required", str(amount))

    ensure_utc(at)
    payment.refunded_amount += amount
    if payment.refunded_amount == payment.amount:
        payment.status = "refunded"
    audit.record(
        "payment_refunded",
        payment_id=payment.id,
        amount=amount,
        requested_by=requested_by,
    )
    return payment
EOF

"""Entry points used by the support console."""

from . import audit
from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError
from .money import ZERO, round_money

APPROVAL_THRESHOLD = round_money("500.00")


def _parse(amount):
    """Parse the agent-entered amount text into a rounded Decimal."""
    return round_money(amount)


def process_refund_request(payment, amount, requested_by, at, *, approved_by=None):
    """Refund part or all of a captured payment on behalf of a support agent."""
    amount = _parse(amount)
    if amount <= ZERO:
        raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(amount))
    if payment.status != "captured":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"payment {payment.id} is {payment.status}")
    if payment.refunded_amount + amount > payment.amount:
        raise BillingError("refund_exceeds_captured", str(amount))
    if amount > APPROVAL_THRESHOLD and approved_by is None:
        raise BillingError("approval_required", str(amount))

    ensure_utc(at)
    payment.refunded_amount += amount
    if payment.refunded_amount == payment.amount:
        payment.status = "refunded"
    audit.record(
        "payment_refunded",
        payment_id=payment.id,
        amount=amount,
        requested_by=requested_by,
    )
    return payment
